description: v0.10.8 Session plugin bridge for the unofficial VamMCP server. Load as a Session Plugin so it survives scene changes. Supports scene/look/clothing/pose, facial expressions, lock_head, person position/rotation, morphs, hair and clothing toggles, character save/load, call_action and set_bool_param on any storable, and the Hub browser. capture_view grabs the real back buffer so the character is actually in the picture. Ignores a leftover command file at load instead of replaying it. An op that fails comes back as ok=false and is written to output_log.txt as a message rather than an error, so a routine miss no longer raises a red toast in the VAM UI.
credits: Unofficial community project. Not affiliated with Mesh VR / Virt-A-Mate.
instructions:
1. From the repository run scripts\install-dev.ps1 -VamRoot VAM_ROOT.
2. Confirm the loose script exists at VAM_ROOT\Custom\Scripts\VamMcp\Bridge\VamMcpBridge.cs.
3. User Preferences -> Security -> Enable Plugins (recommended: Plugins Always Enabled).
4. Main UI (Esc) -> Session Plugins -> Add Plugin -> Custom/Scripts/VamMcp/Bridge/VamMcpBridge.cs. Leave enabled on.
5. Session Plugin Presets -> Change User Defaults -> Set Current As User Defaults.
6. Run the vam-mcp Python server with VAM_ROOT pointed at this install and keep VAM running.
